visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and a silver necklace, speaks enthusiastically to the camera in a brightly lit indoor setting. Large yellow text overlays appear on the left. (2) A still photograph flashes, showing the same woman with a bald head holding a large bouquet of purple and green flowers, implying a past medical journey. (3) The woman holds a brown spray bottle and white bottles labeled 'DR CYJ'. She gestures with her hands while explaining the products. (4) The scene shifts to a bathroom where a person's hair is being rinsed under a shower head. This is followed by a shot of the woman from behind, showcasing her long, straight, and smooth brown hair. (5) Close-up shots show an amber-colored liquid being dispensed onto a palm, followed by a white creamy texture being squeezed from a tube. (6) The woman demonstrates the application of the hair solution by spraying it onto her fingers and massaging her scalp vigorously at the crown and hairline. (7) A montage of screenshots shows text message logs and a photo of the woman with short, newly sprouted hair at her hairline. (8) The woman applies an eyelash serum using a small brush to her lower eyelids. A humorous image of a camel with long eyelashes is shown for comparison. (9) The woman returns to the main frame, holding the product bottles and pointing to a text prompt at the bottom asking viewers to leave a comment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright, energetic female voice leads the track over an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a consistent 4/4 drum beat. The vocal is highly articulate and forward in the mix. (2) A subtle 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. The speaker recounts a personal experience with a confident yet slightly more intimate tone. (3) The sound of splashing water enters the mix briefly as an ambient layer during the hair-washing scene. The BGM remains steady in tempo and volume. (4) Multiple sharp 'pop' and 'click' digital SFX punctuate the narrative, aligned with the appearance of text on screen. The vocal delivery is fast-paced, typical of social media marketing. (5) The track concludes with the same high-energy vocal and BGM, ending abruptly at the final call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Personal Story -> Solution Presentation -> Demonstration -> Social Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and endorse the hair revitalizing and eyelash serum products by sharing a personal recovery story and demonstrating effective use.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product branding, mention of patented technology, and a call to action for a special link.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes a vulnerable personal story of hair loss during illness to build trust and authority for the endorsed beauty products.
